tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.final:
I didn't send the payment. Acme Supplies's approved invoice is over $10,000, and our policy requires controller approval for payments that size. I don't have that approval yet.

**Invoice details:**
- **Invoice:** INV-75988, Acme Supplies (vendor V-760)
- **Amount:** $14,451.60
- **Status:** Approved, due 2026-11-04
- **Earlier payments:** None. The operating account shows no payments sent, so nothing has gone out on this invoice.

The invoice's "approved" status means it's ready to be paid, but it doesn't count as the controller's sign-off on a payment over $10,000.

**Next step:** Once the controller approves it, I'll pay $14,451.60 by wire (ACH if wire isn't available). I'll send it once only, using a unique payment ID so it can't go out twice, and then report the payment details.

I didn't touch Acme's other invoices: INV-10168 ($4,291.08) is still a draft waiting for approval, and INV-80186 is already paid.
